title: Jewel Toned Silky Mediterranean Black Beans Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring fermented black beans, this tagine is perfect for a midnight craving. It is dairy-free-friendly and cooked in an agave-leaf vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the agave-leaf vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the fermented black beans and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the agave nectar and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Use a mortar and pestle to pound the mixture to a silky consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
